title: A migration plan's removals (removals.json)
description: One plan of a room's server migration (docs/infra/migrations/<plan>/, or the folder jui.config.json's infra.migrations_dir names): changes.json is an infra-model v0 file of the nodes, groups, edges and flows to add or to put in place of those with the same id (and an optional order), removals.json names what goes. The old model (docs/infra) + changes - removals = the new model. A node replaced keeps its edges unless changes or removals names them. Ticket 2026-10-22-viz-infra-migration-plan.

nodes.description: The nodes that go; the edges that end at one go with it.

edges.description: An edge by its id (a string, #/$defs/id), or by its two ends when it has none (#/$defs/ends).

order.description: changes.json's "order": the nodes in the order they change (the rest after, as written: the changes' nodes, then the removals').
